name: Cheyenne
description:
Cheyenne Bodie was a big man, a former army scout who went west after the American Civil War and drifted from job to job, here a cowboy, there a lawman, and always a larger-than-life hero.

CHEYENNE is an American western television series of 108 black-and-white episodes broadcast on ABC from 1955 to 1963. The show was the first hour-long western, and in fact the first hour-long dramatic series of any kind, with continuing characters, to last more than one season. It was also the first series to be made by a major Hollywood film studio which did not derive from its established film properties, and the first of a long chain of Warner Brothers original series produced by William T. Orr.

videos.title: The Lonely Gunfighter: The Legacy of Cheyenne
videos.overview: A season 1 DVD extra, this featurette is a recent interview with Clint Walker. Clint tells how he got into show business and about auditioning and filming Cheyenne.

videos.title: Mountain Fortress
videos.overview: Cheyenne, Smitty and a woman they just rescued from an Indian attack are trapped by a band of desperados in their fortified mountain hideaway.

videos.title: Julesburg
videos.overview: Trying to guide a lost wagon train, Cheyenne and Smitty tangle with a gang of cattle rustlers.

videos.title: The Argonauts
videos.overview: Cheyenne tries to help two prospectors in their search for a gold mine, but then they encounter renegade Indians who try to rob them.

videos.title: Border Showdown
videos.overview: Pursuing the bandits who killed a friend of theirs, Cheyenne and Smitty find that the gang has taken over an entire town and only the local padre has the courage to stand against them.

videos.title: The Outlander
videos.overview: Cheyenne's previous acquaintance with a woman involves him in blackmail and nearly gets him killed.

videos.title: The Travelers
videos.overview: Deputy Cheyenne is forced to bring an outlaw in for a murder Cheyenne doesn't think he committed after the US Marshal is killed in a shootout. At the same time the father of the victim is trailing Cheyenne and wants to hang the outlaw.

videos.title: Decision
videos.overview: Guiding a cavalry troop through Indian territory, Cheyenne leads a mutiny to avoid a massacre.

videos.title: The Storm Riders
videos.overview: Cheyenne is driving a herd of horses across land he thought was open range. The owner, Martin Storm, roughs him up and steals them. He gets help from a local rancher who has been trying to rid the valley of this menace since he got there.

videos.title: Rendezvous at Red Rock
videos.overview: Cheyenne comes upon a man who has just been shot. Arrested by a few riders and on the way to Laramie, a hidden benefactor frees him. Their new friendship is shaken when he finds the real reason he saved him and who he really is.

videos.title: West of the River
videos.overview: It's been five years since Ed McKeever's two daughters, Ruth and Jenny, were kidnapped by Chief Tanaka. A scout has just located the women and Cheyenne is assigned to lead the rescue mission of volunteers made up mostly of stockade prisoners from a nearby fort.

videos.title: Quicksand
videos.overview: Cheyenne meets a sly Indian's test of courage to save a wagonload of white settlers.

videos.title: Fury at Rio Hondo
videos.overview: In a Mexico wracked by political unrest, Cheyenne tangles with revolutionaries, a con man and a blonde pickpocket.

videos.title: Star in the Dust
videos.overview: A small-town sheriff, whom Cheyenne admires, is hoodwinked by a woman.

videos.title: Johnny Bravo
videos.overview: Cheyenne's friend falls for a rancher's pretty daughter, but the rancher prefers Cheyenne as his son-in-law.

videos.title: The Last Train West
videos.overview: The train to California carries some mighty interesting passengers, including Cheyenne and his...

videos.title: The Dark Rider
videos.overview: Murder enters the dealings when Cheyenne gets involved with a charming swindler on a cattle drive.

videos.title: The Long Winter
videos.overview: Cheyenne waits out a winter with a cattle drive.

videos.title: Death Deals the Hand
videos.overview: Cheyenne and Hoot Hollister take the river boat to St. Louis for a night on the town.

videos.title: The Bounty Killers
videos.overview: Marshal Frank Moxon saves Cheyenne's life.

videos.title: The Law Man
videos.overview: Cheyenne is sent by the Cattlemen's Association to stop a cattle rustling.

videos.title: Mustang Trail
videos.overview: Cheyenne hunts wild horses.

videos.title: Lone Gun
videos.overview: Cheyenne is forced into a gunfight with the Laverson brothers, leaving two dead and one out for revenge.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Cheyenne rides into Stagge City (pop. 407) and is promptly arrested on trumped-up vagrant charges. After a "trial" lasting less then a minute, he's sentenced to 90 days hard-labor at the nearby silver mine - owned by Stagge.

videos.title: The Iron Trail
videos.overview: Cheyenne takes an old mill train home.

videos.title: Land Beyond the Law
videos.overview: Cheyenne is suspected of being a member of the Ellwood gang.

videos.title: Test of Courage
videos.overview: Cheyenne must get a herd of horses to a desolate cavalry base.

videos.title: War Party
videos.overview: While panning gold, Morgan Trude shoots Cheyenne, thinking he is going to rob him.

videos.title: Deadline
videos.overview: Cheyenne helps an honest newspaper in a fight against a crooked man.

videos.title: Big Ghost Basin
videos.overview: Cheyenne rides into Crowheart carrying a dead man he found along the trail.

videos.title: Born Bad
videos.overview: While working as a small town sheriff Cheyenne falls for a girl who's father was a sheriff & her brother is a killer.

videos.title: The Brand
videos.overview: Cheyenne Bodie (Clint Walker) stops at a cabin for help with a lame horse, and is shot at. He soon ends up on the wrong side of a posse.

videos.title: Decision at Gunsight
videos.overview: Cheyenne takes over a livery stable in exchange for money he is owed. Then he finds out why he got it so cheap. A protection racket runs the town and Cheyenne faces a showdown with the leader when he refuses to pay.

videos.title: The Spanish Grant
videos.overview: The only survivor of a stage coach robbery is an infant boy. He is also the heir to a large land grant and someone else wants the land.

videos.title: Hard Bargain
videos.overview: A bank robber that Cheyenne is bringing in, saves him when he's caught in a bear trap.

videos.title: The Broken Pledge
videos.overview: An Indian uprising results when reporter Fay Kirby tries to interview Sitting Bull.

videos.title: Incident at Indian Springs
videos.overview: A schoolmaster kills an outlaw. His reward: The school is besieged by the outlaw's brothers.

videos.title: The Conspirators
videos.overview: Clint Walker sings and dances as Cheyenne poses as an actor to expose a ring of Southern subversives.

videos.title: The Mutton Puncher
videos.overview: Cheyenne serves as the stake in a poker game---and a pretty rancher wins.

videos.title: Border Affair
videos.overview: Sebastian Cabot and Erin O'Brien play an aging general and his unwilling bride.

videos.title: Devil's Canyon
videos.overview: Cheyenne guides a group of ruthless fortune hunters on a dangerous search for buried diamonds.

videos.title: Town of Fear
videos.overview: An entire town turns against Cheyenne when he tries to prove a friend is not guilty of murder.

videos.title: Hired Gun
videos.overview: A rancher who hired Cheyenne fears he's a gunman out to kill him.

videos.title: Top Hand
videos.overview: Cheyenne turns down the job of top hand for rancher Ben Gentry but finds two more offers awaiting him for the same job.

videos.title: The Last Comanchero
videos.overview: Cheyenne must stand up to a lynch mob to protect his captive, a man who sold guns to the Indians.

videos.title: The Gamble
videos.overview: Cheyenne takes over a saloon for a woman whose daughter is coming home after years in the East.

videos.title: Renegades
videos.overview: An Indian-hating colonel threatens to ruin Cheyenne's peace negotiations.

videos.title: The Empty Gun
videos.overview: When Matt Reardon tries to aid the widow of a man he killed, he learns her son is out for vengeance.

videos.title: White Warrior
videos.overview: Cheyenne, leading a wagon train in Apache territory, meets a band of braves and tries to free a teenage captive from them.

videos.title: Ghost of the Cimarron
videos.overview: Forced to aid a wounded gunman, Cheyenne is mistaken for a gang member by lawmen.

videos.title: Wagon-Tongue North
videos.overview: Cheyenne, in disguise, acts as a trail boss for a woman whose husband he killed in self-defense.

videos.title: The Long Search
videos.overview: A 10-year-old boy has disappeared, and Cheyenne is aided in the search by a Sioux youth, whose tribe has been accused of kidnapping the boy.

videos.title: Standoff
videos.overview: Cheyenne aids a village that faces destruction by an outlaw who's avenging the deaths of two of his men.

videos.title: Dead to Rights
videos.overview: A suave attorney stymies Cheyenne's hunt for a killer.

videos.title: Noose at Noon
videos.overview: An innocent man must hang for murder – or his wife will be killed.

videos.title: The Angry Sky
videos.overview: A woman comes to Cheyenne's aid after he is wounded while trailing a killer.

videos.title: Blind Spot
videos.overview: A sinister plot interrupts Cheyenne's efforts to unite a family split by the Civil War.

videos.title: The Reprieve
videos.overview: Cheyenne poses as robber Wes McQueen to find the late crook's hidden loot.

videos.title: The Rebellion
videos.overview: Cheyenne gets mixed up in a murder plot while delivering printing equipment.

videos.title: Trial by Conscience
videos.overview: Taking a cue from "Hamlet," Cheyenne uses an old stage trick to trap a killer.

videos.title: The Imposter
videos.overview: Cheyenne hires on as a ranch hand to investigate murder and fraud.

videos.title: Prisoner of Moon Mesa
videos.overview: Cheyenne faces a hostile countryside when he replaces a popular foreman.

videos.title: Gold, Glory and Custer - Prelude (1)
videos.overview: This two-part episode depicts events leading up to the famous Little Bighorn massacre. As an Indian scout with Col. Custer's regiment, Cheyenne Bodie helps search for gold on a Sioux reservation. (Part 1 of 2)

videos.title: Gold, Glory and Custer - Requiem (2)
videos.overview: Colonel Custer's regiment is wiped out in the Battle of the Little Bighorn. Risking a charge of desertion, Cheyenne decides to appear at Major Reno's court martial. (Part 2 of 2)

videos.title: Riot at Arroyo Soco
videos.overview: Shooting the son of a prominent citizen wasn't the most popular act of Cheyenne's career---but it was the only way to stop a lynch mob.

videos.title: Apache Blood
videos.overview: Cheyenne sides with a white man raised by Apaches when a vengeful character tries to break up his marriage.

videos.title: Outcast of Cripple Creek
videos.overview: Disgusted by corruption, Cheyenne resigns as marshal and is promptly jailed – but his successor can't keep the peace alone.

videos.title: Alibi for the Scalped Man
videos.overview: A bridegroom disappears and Cheyenne is jailed on a trumped-up murder charge.

videos.title: Home Is the Brave
videos.overview: The enemies of a dead hero try to prevent his honorable burial.

videos.title: The Long Rope
videos.overview: Cheyenne is reminded of a scene from his boyhood when Fred Baker comes to him for help.

videos.title: Counterfeit Gun
videos.overview: Cheynne is guarding a gold shipment when thieves attack, steal the gold and kill a man.

videos.title: Road to Three Graves
videos.overview: Delivering mine equipment, Cheyenne runs into a feud between rival mine owners.

videos.title: Two Trails to Santa Fe
videos.overview: An Apache woman named Alleah is to be tortured to death for marrying a white man. Cheyenne helps her to escape and the angry Apaches ride to attack a nearby mining settlement in retaliation.

videos.title: Savage Breed
videos.overview: Al Lestrade, Dodge City's marshal, is on vacation, hunting buffalo. But a cartridge from the shot fired to stampede an approaching herd is traced to Lestrade's rifle.

videos.title: Incident at Dawson Flats
videos.overview: Arriving at a friend's wedding, Cheyenne becomes the target in a murder plot that could turn into a massacre.

videos.title: Duel at Judas Basin
videos.overview: "Duel at Judas Basin" combines the trinity of Cheyenne, Bronco, and Sugarfoot in one episode. This 'summit meeting' provides an exciting episode for young fans knowing that the bad guys didn't have a chance. But one gets framed for murder, jailed and broken out; another is working undercover to infiltrate the bad guys, is almost taken prisoner, gets away, and all the while Cheyenne has to hold it all together as the three fight the local law, Crazy Horse and the bad guys.

videos.title: The Return of Mr. Grimm
videos.overview: A hate-filled father arranges a lynching for Cheyenne to avenge the death of his son, killed while resisting arrest.

videos.title: The Beholden
videos.overview: Cheyenne no sooner brings a robber in than a marshal releases him.

videos.title: The Frightened Town
videos.overview: Outlaws take over an entire town, but only Cheyenne is willing to help the marshal (Andrew Duggan).

videos.title: Lone Patrol
videos.overview: A stubborn cavalry captain ignores Cheyenne's advice---and leads his patrol into certain slaughter.

videos.title: Massacre at Gunsight Pass
videos.overview: Cheyenne's in the middle when Indians attack the stage in which he and his prisoner are traveling.

videos.title: The Greater Glory
videos.overview: Cheyenne and Billy the Kid join forces to help a woman in trouble.

videos.title: Winchester Quarantine
videos.overview: A fiery cattlewoman involves Cheyenne in her business and her life.

videos.title: Trouble Street
videos.overview: Cheyenne stops in Colton City to put up some supplies and a man by the name of Kell provokes him into a fight.

videos.title: Cross Purpose
videos.overview: A bride is left in the lurch when her groom turns fugitive on their wedding day.

videos.title: The Young Fugitives
videos.overview: Cheyenne visits an old friend only to find him in a wheelchair. His son is a loner, laughed at by the town. He wins a rifle in a contest but runs away when the town wants to lynch him for an act of self defense.

videos.title: Day's Pay
videos.overview: On the trail of a sheriff's killer, Cheyenne is interrupted by a town's plea for help in dealing with a gang of terrorists.

videos.title: Retaliation
videos.overview: Townspeople oppose Cheyenne as he tries to capture robbers who made off with an unpopular tycoon's fortune.

videos.title: Storm Center
videos.overview: A young orphan begs Cheyenne to help him find his parents. Cheyenne agrees---then the boy himself disappears.

videos.title: Legacy of the Lost
videos.overview: Cheyenne learns that his white father may still be alive.

videos.title: The Brahma Bull
videos.overview: A bull complicates Cheyenne's efforts to help a sick child.

videos.title: The Wedding Rings
videos.overview: Cheyenne tangles with a bandit who named himself dictator of a Mexican province.

videos.title: The Idol
videos.overview: The Kirby brothers are determined to kill gunfighter Ben Shelby---but it's Cheyenne they have cornered.

videos.title: One Way Ticket
videos.overview: Cheyenne's distractions while escorting an outlaw to jail: the outlaw's friends, the outlaw's enemies---and a pretty widow.

videos.title: The Bad Penny
videos.overview: When four men receive notes threatening their lives, Cheyenne suggests the notes may have come from a newcomer in town.  This gets a hearty laugh, because the new arrival is pretty young Penelope Piper.

videos.title: A Man Called Ragan
videos.overview: Marshal Frank Ragan rides into Stark City to visit Johnny Wilson. But Wilson has disappeared and cattle baron Ben Stark tells Ragan he had better do the same. Clint Walker does not appear in this episode, which was the pilot for the series The Dakotas; hence, it is not included in the DVD release of season six.

videos.title: The Durango Brothers
videos.overview: After defeating a bully, Cheyenne discovers his prize: the man's old-maid sister (Sally Kellerman).

videos.title: Satonka
videos.overview: Cheyenne's after a killer and Indians tell him his quarry is a monster called Satonka.

videos.title: Sweet Sam
videos.overview: Shortly after arriving in Rock Springs, Sam Pridemore stops a killer and becomes a town hero. Cheyenne knows the man and suspects he is after the gold in the bank.

videos.title: Man Alone
videos.overview: Cheyenne helps a wounded cowboy who is suffering from amnesia. He suspects the man was a member of a band of outlaws that robbed the Cattlemen's Association.

videos.title: The Quick and the Deadly
videos.overview: Jud Ainley is on trial for murder and the main witness against him, lawman Harry Thomas is discredited as a witness and charged with robbery.

videos.title: Indian Gold
videos.overview: Charlie Teeney and his followers go looking for gold on the Sioux reservation after they see White Crow come into town with two small bags of gold.

videos.title: Dark Decision
videos.overview: A blind singer, under the spell of a crooked gambler, backs up an accusation of murder against Cheyenne.

videos.title: Pocketful of Stars
videos.overview: Cheyenne is involved in an Indian uprising when the railroad threatens to run through sacred burial grounds.

videos.title: The Vanishing Breed
videos.overview: Cheyenne, appointed to the state senate, starts a campaign to preserve the buffalo.

videos.title: Vengeance Is Mine
videos.overview: Cheyenne's first job as sheriff: quell a friend's thirst for vengeance.

videos.title: Johnny Brassbuttons
videos.overview: An Indian is accused of treason when an Army unit he's leading gets ambushed.

videos.title: Wanted for the Murder of Cheyenne Bodie
videos.overview: Cheyenne is charged with murder---his own.

videos.title: Showdown at Oxbend
videos.overview: Cheyenne takes on an evil cattleman (Andrew Duggan).

awards: Nominated for 1 Primetime Emmy. 1 win & 1 nomination total
